info.title: Saga of Tanya the Evil: The Movie
info.synopsis: Tanya Degurechov, capelli biondi, occhi azzurri, carnagione pallida e quasi trasparente, è sempre in prima linea, vola sui campi di battaglia e uccide senza alcuna pietà il nemico. Nonostante il suo difetto di pronuncia, comanda un'intera armata. Tanya faceva parte dell'élite burocratica giapponese, ma per via delle ire di un dio, si è reincarnata nel corpo di una ragazzina, e ora non pensa ad altro che all'ottimizzazione e all'avanzamento della sua carriera, e ciò la rende la più pericolosa strega dell'Armata Imperiale.

tvdb.synopsis: Vooren Glanz, Wilibald Koenig, Rhiner Neumann and Matheus Johan Weiss are in a room while Neumann and Koenig complained to Weiss about his drunk attitude that scares women away, this caused them being not popular around women. Weiss will sexually harass women with words while he is drunk, which he claims it as only being compliments.Upon hearing this fact, the three was shocked especially Vooren. Weiss promised that he will not make the mistake again, then they went to get drinks.Unfortunately, Weiss got drunk and sexually harassed women. The other three stood aside, talking how they view alcohol as a prohibited item for Weiss then on. Suddenly, Viktoriya Ivanovna Serebryakov appeared being uncomfortable with two men harassing her. The four helped Visha and drove the men away. Visha being grateful to them as she does not know that Weiss harassed women sexually when he is drunk.
